brief:
# Build: ui-review-shots (Urgent profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): UI Review shows items but NO pictures. Assigned agent: **Snap Sully** (book on his card; AXF_AGENT=snap-sully if supported). Register in Urgent (id `ui-review-shots`) + banner entry. Fix it, then tell.

## Evidence
- Headless builds on the VPS submit UI Review items from their worktrees (/root/axf-builds/<name>/), e.g. menu-scroll: item `r-20261103-2637fd91`, 11 shots, group 'menu-scroll - Nov 3 6:20 PM'. Others today: builds-one-page-done (#269), md-studio (#271), console-wake (#266), molly-fable `r-20261103-80e15b02`, xlayout (3 items).
- Brett opened UI Review in the live console (axf-console container, console.amberxai.com) and sees the items with no images.

## Do
- s1 Find the cause: where review.mjs / rebuild-shots --submit write the image files vs where the console's ui-review server reads/serves them (likely: images stay in the build worktree or a sandbox path the axf-console container can't see; or paths are relative to the worktree; or they're in axHub _data but the console serves a different root; or the image route 404s / auth).
- s2 Fix so every shot is stored somewhere permanent and shared (axHub _data ui-review/ or a mounted volume the console reads), with stable URLs; images uploaded at submit time, never pointing into a worktree that gets deleted.
- s3 Backfill: re-attach the existing shots for every waiting item today (copy from /root/axf-builds/*/ shots folders, reports' shots/, or re-capture with rebuild-shots if the files are gone). Every waiting item must show its pictures.
- s4 health@1 check: red if any UI Review item has shots that fail to load. Item rows show a thumbnail; broken image shows 'shot missing' plus a Re-capture button, never a blank.
- s5 Tests (submit from a fake worktree -> image visible in console after the worktree is deleted), report `_claude/builds/reports/ui-review-shots.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.

s2 Fix: shots load reliably from the shared store (stop the status request storm that starves them)
s3 Backfill: every waiting item shows its pictures
s4 health@1 check + shot missing / Re-capture in the UI
